title: Workbench panel element configurations
description: Each panel type's element configuration (_data/workbench/panel-elements.json, ADR-031 decision 4, REQ-011 R12): the body kind its content is, and the ordered list of bar elements it supplies, one entry per place the element takes in a slot's top bar. Structural eligibility is computed from this and slot-schemas.json; nothing lists the slots a panel may occupy. The relational rules (a body kind or bar type exists in the slot-schema vocabulary; every PANEL_REGISTRY type has an entry) are asserted by test/test_workbench_slot_matcher.py.
